subject: Post-demo recap + simple unblock path for Arksense PoC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@arksense.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@arksense.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + small next steps after demo — Arksense PoC

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a low-friction plan to get a small PoC running so you can validate latency and cost on a representative workload: 

1) Goal we agreed on
- Measure inference latency at 250 token prompts and evaluate 2k embedding throughput on a sample of your customer transcripts.

2) Proposed minimal PoC (2 weeks, non-prod):
- Redwood hosted endpoint with pre-selected model (gpt-medium-qa)
- 100k token credit + dedicated support slot for initial setup
- Simple evaluation harness (we provide a script) to run 3 load patterns

3) Immediate next steps (who/when)
- Arksense: share 2 example prompt sets and a representative embedding corpus (Lisa/Tom) — by EOD Fri if possible
- Redwood: provision PoC endpoint and send POC-Checklist + Quickstart (Karthik) — within 24 hrs once artifacts received

I attached a short POC-Checklist that lists the bare minimum files/config we need (POC-Checklist.pdf). If procurement or security needs a one-pager, I can send a tailored one with licensing and data handling language.

If priority has changed, tell me — we can delay and I'll follow up in a couple weeks. Otherwise, does Thurs 11/12 at 10am PT work for a 20-30m setup call to kick off?

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM serving

Attachments: POC-Checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@arksense.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@arksense.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Quick nudge — offer to help unblock Arksense PoC (technical + procurement)

Hey Lisa / Tom — following up on my note below. I haven't seen the sample prompts yet and wanted to share a lower-effort path if the team is stretched: 

Alternative "zero-lift" pilot (if you can't carve out infra time):
- Redwood hosts a short, pre-configured evaluation using a sanitized sample we can prepare from public transcripts
- You get a 30-min walkthrough + a short report on latency/cost so stakeholders see value without setup overhead
- We can include a 30-day, non-recurring credit and an expedited SOW for procurement

I'll also offer to loop in our contracts lead to pre-fill the SOW with standard enterprise terms so procurement has less back-and-forth (attaching Draft-SOW-v1.docx for reference).

If this is still a "not now," please say so and I'll hold off — otherwise, if procurement is the blocker, can you cc procurement@arksense.com and I'll get an updated quote and a one-pager over by EOD?

If helpful, available times this week for a quick sync: Wed 11/18 11am PT, Thu 11/19 2pm PT. If neither works, tell me a time window and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the clarity — I want to make it as easy as possible for you to evaluate and not add to the backlog.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: POC-Quickstart.pdf (2 pages), Draft-SOW-v1.docx (stub)

From: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@arksense.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@arksense.com>, Arksense Procurement <procurement@arksense.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick nudge — offer to help unblock Arksense PoC (technical + procurement)

Karthik —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the options — sorry for the radio silence. We liked the demo but we're temporarily deprioritizing new vendor evaluations while Q4 priorities are locked down. Procurement is tied up with an internal licensing review and won't be able to move on an SOW until December.

That said, we're still interested and I want to keep this alive. Two quick asks so we can hand this to procurement without another round of back-and-forth: 
- Can you send a one-page summary (product + data handling) I can give procurement?
- An updated draft SOW/quote showing a single, short PoC line-item (so they can pencil it into the queue)

If you can get those two items to procurement@arksense.com by end of next week, I'll push to get it scheduled for review. Thanks for being flexible — appreciate the low-friction options.

Tom
Director, Product Engineering
Arksense
